title: You were never meant for power (F4F)
description: You were never meant for power. It's something you might have had at one point in the past or presently. Something that you crave. Something that I will forcibly take away. For you were never meant to hold it. You will be brought under my control, slave, And bit by bit you find yourself softening to my voice. I will drop you down under my control, strap you down to my Saint Andrew's Cross and beat it from you. Until you fully understand that power must be wielded responsibly. When I'm done with you, you'll thank me for taking it from you, you'll beg me to do it again and again. Stripped of control, stripped of power Unto that cross, sinking deep into trance. Being in trance feels good. Obeying feels good. Being a good slave feels good. But tell me— when you had power, did you use it wisely? I’ve been reading, I've been looking. You’ve been very, very naughty. You’ve had your moments, you’ve had your fun. And now ? Now is the time to repent.
author: Mistress Shibby
